target: Historical numerical systolic ratio, not certified; no capacity/volume recomputation
features: Uniform distinct centered factor vertices; m_k=E[(X dot Y)^k]/E[(X dot Y)^2]^(k/2). Predictors use abs(m3),abs(m5).
protocol: Five predeclared low-complexity OLS designs, no tuning: exact side-count bucket holdout and independent name-hash holdout; top-decile order and recall within each bucket.
